paragraphs: The ML400 was part of the third-generation M-Class (W166), produced from 2011 to 2015 before the model was rebadged as the GLE. It uses a 3.0-litre twin-turbo petrol V6 — a more powerful alternative to the ML350 petrol V6, positioned between the mainstream six-cylinder models and the full-fat V8s. The ML400 effectively replaced the ML500 in some markets during the W166 generation, offering strong performance with better fuel economy than the larger V8.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every ML400 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the ML400 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
